title: The tree is an oil rig
body: The 145-foot tree at the center of the park is built around a refitted offshore oil-rig platform, chosen because it could carry the weight of the trunk, the branches, and the theater hidden inside the roots. More than 300 animals are carved into the trunk and roots. Sculptors worked from the top down so a finished animal was never damaged by the scaffolding for the next one.
